title: Volunteer Hours by Cause
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=volunteer:shift
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(hours) as hours by cause _time
| stats sum(hours) as total_hours by cause
| sort - total_hours
description: Adds up the hours you give to each cause so you can see where your time and heart really go.
value: Seeing your volunteering by cause helps you give intentionally rather than drifting into whatever asks loudest.
implementation: Ingest volunteer shifts into `index=personal`; total hours by cause.
visualization: Bar chart of volunteer hours by cause.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the hours you give to each good cause, showing where your time and heart really go.
